cues: And here is the deeper trick of this unit: connectives with the same meaning need different grammar.
Because takes a clause; because of takes a noun; therefore needs a full stop or a semicolon in front of it.
text: And here is the deeper trick of this unit: connectives with the same meaning need different grammar. Because takes a clause; because of takes a noun; therefore needs a full stop or a semicolon in front of it. Meaning is not enough. Always check what must follow.
